entities.name: María del Carmen Iglesias Cano
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: María del Carmen Iglesias Cano, 1st Countess of Gisbert, is a Spanish historian. She is the Director of the Real Academia de la Historia. In this role she has been responsible for the launch of the electronic version of Spain's dictionary of national biography, the Diccionario biográfico español. She is also a member of the Royal Spanish Academy, which regulates the Spanish language.

In this role she has been responsible for the launch of the electronic version of Spain's dictionary of national biography, the Diccionario biográfico español.
